# TypeRush

> TypeRush is a free online typing speed test and typing contest platform. Users measure WPM and accuracy, practice with real-time feedback, and compete in live global typing contests and leaderboards.

## Core Features
- Typing speed test (WPM, accuracy, graphs)
- Practice mode with paragraph-based tests
- Org-hosted typing contests
- Global and org-level leaderboards

## Key Pages
- Practice: https://typerush.app/practice
- Leaderboard: https://typerush.app/leaderboard
- Contests: https://typerush.app/contests
